description:
Diagnose SQL performance against an IRIS namespace (read-only). Actions:

- **explain** (read): show the query plan via `EXPLAIN <query>` (returns the plan text). Requires 'query'.
- **stats** (read): per-statement cumulative runtime statistics from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.STATEMENTS. Optional 'filter' (substring on the Statement text) and 'maxRows'.
- **indexUsage** (read): the maps/indexes a query reads, derived from its `EXPLAIN` plan. Requires 'query'.
- **running** (read): currently-executing statements from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.CURRENT_STATEMENTS. Optional 'filter' (substring on UserName) and 'maxRows'.
- **advise** (read, SQL Performance Advisor): evidence-cited findings (full-scan, missing-index, stale-stats, unused-index, plan-anomaly) for a 'query' or the recent statement 'workload' (mutually exclusive). 'topN' (default 5, max 20) caps workload breadth — each statement analyzed is a full round-trip, i.e. real scan work, not just an output-size cap. Recommendations are heuristic; verify with 'explain' before applying any change — this action never applies anything itself.

All five actions are READ-ONLY and enabled by default.

filter.description: Optional case-insensitive substring filter for 'stats' (matches the Statement text) and 'running' (matches UserName)

maxRows.description: Maximum number of rows to return for tabular actions (default: 1000)

query.description: SQL query to analyze (REQUIRED for 'explain' and 'indexUsage'; for 'advise', mutually exclusive with 'workload')

server.description: Named server profile to target for this call (from `IRIS_PROFILES`). Omit to use the default server.

topN.description: 'advise' + 'workload' only: number of recent statements to analyze (default: 5, max: 20). This caps analysis breadth, which IS scan work — each statement is a full endpoint round-trip.

workload.description: 'advise' only: advise on the top-N recent statements instead of one 'query' (mutually exclusive with 'query')

name: iris_sql_analyze
title: Analyze SQL
